activity_summary: On the bench Susanna gave the fire in order, from the cry about two to twenty houses and barns and nobody hurt. Judith gave the widow and the hens, and the bailiff's man shouting at the wind. Hamnet gave the top of the street, Richard turning him back, and the bent nail. You said the three back, and you did not take the nail.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard all three, and kept them apart.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the order, and kept nobody hurt at the end of it.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the widow and the man shouting at the wind.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the street, the turning back, and the nail.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Named as the one who turned Hamnet back. Not on the bench.

quotes.speaker: susanna_shakespeare
quotes.text: The cry was about two in the afternoon

quotes.speaker: judith_shakespeare
quotes.text: The widow would not leave without her hens

quotes.speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
quotes.text: I ran to the top of the street
